units.source_text: 他们在议论着人们关于应该让民间团体捐献的评论。

en.t: They were discussing the comments people had made about how private organizations ought to be made to donate.

units.source_text: 一个沉着的秃头老人没有加人议论，

en.t: A composed bald old man did not join in the discussion,

units.source_text: 一个劲地用不知洗过几万遍的发黄的白麻手绢在指手。

en.t: but kept gesturing with a yellowed white linen handkerchief that looked as if it had been washed tens of thousands of times.
